description:
Make the exit-code projection suite fail for any projected row that no binding test covers, so it can be the only owner of command exit codes.

## Background

`crates/jit/tests/cli_issue/command_exit_code_projection_tests.rs` binds projected command rows in both invocation forms through `assert_projected_exit_status_in_both_forms` (`:156-187`), which asserts the plain status, the JSON status and their equality. Its completeness check `test_command_exit_codes_every_row_is_verified` (`:1128-1185`) compares the generated projection (`CommandSchema::generate().command_exit_codes`, rows in `crates/jit/src/schema.rs`) with a hand-maintained `verified` set, so a row can be listed with no test behind it. `invocation_exit_status_parity_tests.rs` holds two parity cases with no projection row: an id unresolved across namespaces (`:65`) and a malformed stored record (`:133`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The completeness check derives the set of verified rows from the binding cases themselves, so a row passes only when a case binds it in both invocation forms.
- [hard] REQ-02: The two parity cases with no projection row, an id unresolved across namespaces and a malformed stored record, are bound by the projection suite in both forms.
- [hard] REQ-03: Each row of the generated projection has exactly one binding case.
title: Exit-code projection suite proves a binding behind each row
